cartes.texte: You describe your rooms, teachers, groups and rules. Planner places the sessions, and tells you why when it cannot.
Attendance, quizzes, games and polls all happen in the same tool, with the same account.
This page only describes what Planner already does. What is in preparation is marked “Coming soon”.
